_comment: Example dedicated-server config for Cops n Robbers (gamemode 3). Run: python dediserver.py --config configs/copsnrobbers.json. Getaway mode. One getaway driver (turns rotate each round), every other player is a cop and picks a police car. The getaway wins by surviving to 0:00 or escaping 24000 units from every cop for 5 s; the cops win by filling the damage meter (bust). AI police are off so only player cops chase; set "cops": true for extra pressure on the getaway. A car mod's police car (bank sounds.cop) counts as a police car.
name: JERICHO Cops n Robbers
motd: Cops n Robbers - one getaway, everyone else is the law.
